The specific architecture—half-timbered houses (Fachwerk) painted white with dark trim and traditional lanterns—is highly representative of Marburg's 'Oberstadt'. Narrowing to the street level, the curve of the road and the specific orientation of the buildings and the castle wall identify this as Ritterstraße. The building on the right, with its white facade and multiple wall-mounted lanterns, matches the historic structures along this path as it ascends toward the castle grounds.
